title: Major disaster declaration DR-4911-AZ: Severe Storm
summary: FEMA records a major disaster declaration (DR-4911-AZ, "SEVERE STORMS AND FLOODING") for AZ, dated 2026-05-29, for an incident of type "Severe Storm". The incident period began on 2025-10-10 and ended on 2025-10-13. The declaration lists 1 designated area.
